tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal sangs rgyas thod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga de kho

na nyid gsal ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/ dpal sangs rgyas thod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga de kho na nyid gsal ba zhes bya ba/ rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje sangs rgyas rnam sangs rgyas/ /stong pa'i yab gcig lhag pa'i lha/ /gcig pu bde ba che rang bzhin/ /rang byung bcom ldan la phyag 'tshal/ /rgyud 'di gtsor byed nyung ba'i phyir/ /cho ga rab rgyas nyer mkho med/ /zab mo'i chos mchog mi nub phyir/ / don tshang mdor bsdus tsam zhig 'bri/ /de la 'di'i dkyil chog rim pa gsal ba zhes bya ba/ bram ze chen po'i gzhung du grags pa 'di las/ sa chog gi rim pa la cho ga spy-i nag po spyod pas mdzad pa'i bde mchog gi dkyil chog dang 'dra rung ba las/ gsol btab dang gtor sngags sogs mi 'dra ba mang dag dang bcas pa 'byung mod kyi/ sa chog ni gsang ba spyi'i cho ga'i rjes su 'brangs pas don grub cing legs par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gzhan du shes par bya la/ cho ga lhag ma rnams pa/ mi 'jigs pa'i gzhung 'grel las kyang*/ lag len 'debs rung du gsungs mod kyi/ rgyud 'di'i dkyil chog rang rkang tshugs pa phyogs 'dir 'gyur ba ni rim pa gsal ba gcig bu yin pa'i phyir/ cho ga lhag ma rnams gtso bor de'i rjes su bgrang bar bya'o/ /de yang dang por sta gon gyi bya ba la/ sngon du bya ba'i rim pa dang*/ sta gon dngos so/ /dang po ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis byin gyis brlabs/ srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs rnams badzra sa mā dzaḥ a rghaṃ nas shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ buddhā ka pā la badzra tse ṭe/ zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar sgrub thabs kyi gtor chog ltar brjod/ de nas 'phrin bcol spyi dang mthun par yang byas nas/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te gtor ma phyi rol du dor ro/ /de rjes gnas dang yo byad byin gyis brlabs pa yang bde dgyes sogs spyi dang 'dra'o/

/de nas sgrub thabs ltar/ skyabs 'gro nas bzlas pa'i bar dang*/ dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu te/ mngon rtogs rgyas pa rdzogs par sgom/ gnyis pa sta gon dngos ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi'am maṇḍal la sa lha'i mchod gtor tshom bu dang bcas pa bkod/ oṃ haṃ/ haṃ gi sgra dang hūṃ gi 'od kyis bskul nas/ sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa byung*/ tshom bu'i steng du byon pa ni sa'i lha mo gser gyi mdog can zhi ba'i nyams dang ldan pa/ phyag gnyis kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i rin po che'i bum pa bsnams pa/ rgyan dang na bza' dkar po can du gyur/ 'bru gsum gyis mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ pri thi wī de wī bhyaḥ arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhā pe/ ā lo ke gandhe/ nai wi dya/ shapta āḥhūṃ gtor ma/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a las ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hri/ oṃ pri the wī de wī bhyaḥ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ud ga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛhṇe daṃ bha ling ta ye swāhā/ lan gsum/ oṃ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dbang du gyur/ /he ru ka dpal dpa' bo yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi stobs bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las/ /rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri/ oṃ pri thi wī de wī bhyaḥ arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ sa'i lha mo slar yang sa de nyid la thim par gyur/ de rnams sa'i lha mo'i sta gon no/ /de dag bsal te dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi'am/ maṇḍal la lha dang grangs mnyam pa'i tshom bu bkod/ mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su pad nyi ro'i gdan la/

hūṃ dang rdo rje las/ bcom ldan 'das yab yum grub pa na/ nor bu dang nor bu'i 'od zer gyi tshul gyis rnal 'byor ma/ nyi shu rtsa bzhi yang grub pa ni/ dbus su bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka= nas/ brtsed 'jo'i rol pa can no/ /de'i phyi rol shar du phreng bzang ma= sogs/ dbang ldan la sogs pa'i mtshams bzhi la/ g.yas bskor gyi= nas/ thod pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol shar du dge ba'i ske rags can ma= nas/ sdud byed ma'o/ /de'i phyi rol shar du sgrol byed ma= nas/ rlung du grags chen ma'o/ /de'i yang phyi rol shar du mdzes sdug ma/ byang du nor 'dzin ma/ nub tu skal bzang ma/ lhor yid 'ong ma ste/ rnal 'byor ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi po= nas/ zla ba'i rgyun rab tu 'bab pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kar oṃ= nas/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur gyi bar/ go cha gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes pa bstims pa/ dbang bskur rgyas btab/ mchod pa/ bstod pa/ nang gi bdud rtsi myangs ba/ phyi rol gyi bdud rtsi byin gyis brlabs pa rnams mngon rtogs ltar bya/ snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags pa lan gsum brjod pas nang mchod phul/ spros pa la dga' na/ mchod bstod rnams rgyas pa dngos gzhi'i skabs nas kha bskang bas chog go /gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ buddha ka pā li ni ba liṃ gṛ+-ihṇa zhes pa nas/ kun 'grub shog / gi bar gyi 'phrin las bcol/ spos dang bcas pas rdor dril 'dzin pas/ gnyis med ye shes las byung ba'i/ khyab bdag dngos kun bdag nyid can/ /ston pa'i gtso bo khrag 'thung dpal/ /sna tshogs bde mar yang dag ldan/ /phyogs mtshams rnams kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ /rigs pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul can/ /byang chub sems dpa' la sogs kun/ /ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /slob ma la ni phan pa dang*/ khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje can bdag 'di zhes pas/ /nangs par dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/

/rjes su brtse bas nyer dgongs te/ /kun gyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ / zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab bo/ /mchod pa khagasos te/ 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ rtsa brgyad po las byung ba'i/ zhes pa nas/ khyod la bdag 'dud do/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis mchod bstod dang*/ snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum sbyar bas nang mchod phul/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad rang gi sna bug g.yon nas zhugs te snying gar thim/ de rnams lha sta gon no/ /de nas rgyas par na/ lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i bum pa bya ste/ gtso bo'am byang sgo'i lha mo gang rung las/ las bum logs su mi byed pa ltar na/ bum pa nyer lnga yin la/ logs su byed pa ltar na nyer drug go /'on kyang der sang gi lag len ltar na/ las bum logs su byed cing lha bum gcig la bsdu ba yin pas/ bum pa gnyis spyi dang mthun par bshams/ oṃ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las sna tshogs padma'i steng du a las zla ba'i gdan re re/ de'i steng du paṃ las rin po che bum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyi mgul bcings dang*/ dpag bsam gyis shing gi kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba'i rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus su/ pad nyi'i gdan gyi steng du/ g.yon skor gyi a ā i ī nas/ hūṃ yig de nyid kyi snang ba las grub ste/ bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka sku mdog sngon po nas/ rol pa can no/ /shar du phreng bzang ma/ zhes pa nas/ badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ zhes pa'i bar/ lha sta gon gyi skabs dang sgrub thabs bzhin bya/ rtsa brgyad po las byung ba'i nas/ bdag 'dud do/ / zhes mchod bstod dang*/ snying po'i 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ ye shes sems dpa' dang ro gcig tu 'dres pas/ lha rnams byang chub kyi sems kyi ngo bor gyur/

gtso bo'i snying po nyid ci 'grub tu bzla'o/ / las bum gyi nang du hūṃ dang sna tshogs rdo rje las/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ljang khu/ ljang dkar ser ba'i zhal gsum phyag dang po gnyis kyis sna tshogs rdo rje dang thod khrag 'dzin pas/ rang snang gi yum la 'khyud pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i rdo rje 'bar ba dang kha ṭwāṃ ga bsnams pa/ khro bo'i cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ ye shes sems dpa' bdud rtsi 'khyil ba badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badzra kuṇḍa li badzra hūṃ phaṭa/ ces ci nus su bzlas pa'i mthar/ bum pa gnyis kar la thun mong du/ arghaṃ nas/ shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ rdo rje dang ni= sogs dang*/ 'jigs pa'i hūṃ sgra= sogs kyis bstod/ yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang= sogs kyis/ bzod par gsol/ dung phor gyi nang gi he ru ka yang zhu bar gyur/ me tog dang spos la sogs pas mchod do/ /skabs 'dir gtor ma 'bul bar bshad pa 'ga' zhig la yod kyang*/ 'dir bum pa la gtor ma med la/ mdun bskyed la gong gi des chog pas 'dir mi dgos so/ /bum bskyed kyi skabs 'dir/ rim pa gsal ba dang*/ gzhung 'grel dang*/ 'grel pa ye shes ldan gsum nas so sor cung zad mi 'dra ba tsam kho na bshad kyang*/ rgyud las/ mdog dang mtshan mar ldan pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams sa bon gyi/ /'od zer gyi ni rnam par bsam/ /bdag nyid chen po grags chen po/ /bum pa ru ni zhugs tsam gyis/ /dam tshig dkyil 'khor zhu bar gyur/ zhes gsal bar gsungs pa'i rjes su 'brangs pa'o/ /'dir las bum mi byed na bum pa gcig gis kyang rung bar mngon no/ / de rnams bum pa sta gon no/ /de nas slob ma rnams khrus byas/ maṇḍal phul/ thal mo sbyar nas/ 'di'i rjes zlos byed de/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/

/byang chub chen po'i tshul ston pa/ / mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ slob ma rnams zhal du bcug /thugs ka'i hūṃ yig gi 'od zer 'bar bas sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs/ he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin pa'i rnam pas rdo rje'i lam nas lha mo'i padmar phyung shing*/ hūṃ zhes gsang ba'i mkha' nas spros te/ phyi rol du pad nyi la 'khod par mos/ bu tshur theg pa chen po la/ khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni/ khyod la yang dag bshad par bya/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang*/ /de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang*/ /da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'gro la phan phyir gang bzhugs pa/ /de dag kun gyis gsang sngags kyi/ /cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen nas/ / dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med brnyes/ / gsang sngags spyod pa mnyam med de/ /skyob pa dpal ldan he ru kas/ /bdud sde shin tu mi zad pa/ /dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /gong nas gong ma'i sdom pa ni/ /bu khyod kyis ni bzung bya ste/ /grol ba'i rgyu ni de las gzhan/ /thabs ni ci yang yod ma yin/ / zhes slob dpon gyis brjod/ de nas slob mas rgyun bshags lan gsum bya ste/ bdag gis sdig pa bgyis pa dang*/ /bgyid du stsal dang yi rang dang*/ / sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas ni/ /ma lus so sor bshags par bgyi/ / sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /rang rgyal dgra bcom 'gro rnams kyi/ /bsgom dang bzlas brjod bsod nams dang*/

/tshogs dag la ni yi rang ngo*/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ / sangs rgyas thod pa mkha' 'gro ma/ /'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid can/ kun la rtag tu skyabs su mchi/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bdag nyid che/ khyad par du yang slob dpon la/ /rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung dpa' bo dang*/ /rnal 'byor ma dang snang mdzad sogs/ /byang chub sems dpa' dpag med sogs/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /che ge dus 'di nas bzung ste/ /ji srid gnyis med la gnas par/ /de yi tshangs spyod gnyis med pa/ /byang chub mchog sems bskyed par bgyi/ /bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams kyis/ /sangs rgyas myur du bsgrubs byas te/ /sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /bla med gnas su bsgral bar bgyi/ /slob ma skad cig gis he ru kar bskyed pa'i gnas gsum du dri'i thig le dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ las 'khor lo dang*/ padma dang rdo rje rnams yig 'bris mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi nus pa bkug nas bstims la/ spyi bor me tog /mdun du spos/ spyan la mar me/ thugs kar dri/ zhal du lha bshos/ snyan la rol mo rnams 'bul lo/ / de nas u dum wa ra'am/ a shwattha la sogs pa'i so shing sor bcu gnyis pa/ rtse mo me tog ldan pa la/ oṃ hūṃ he bha ga wa ti mu khaṃ pa ri shuddhaṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes lan bdun bsngags pa lag tu byin nas shar ram byang du kha bltas te/ dor ba las dngos grub lung bstan/ de nas/ oṃ hriḥbi shuddha dharma sarba pā paṃ ni tsa a sya bi sho dha ya sarba bi kalpān a pa na ya hūṃ/ zhes pas khyor chu blud nas/ gtso bo'i snying po bzlas pa'i srad bu dmar po la mdud pa gsum dang ldan pas/ skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon/ bud med kyi g.yas/ byis pa'i mgul du bcings pa la/ 'bru gsum brjod nas/

ku sha byin gyis brlabs te sngas dang stan du sbyin par bya'o/ /de nas/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dum wa ra'i me tog ltar/ /brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'di ni/ /de bas kyang ni rnyed dka' ste/ /gang gis mnyam med sems can don/ /bla med par byed nus pa yin/ /gnyis med zab mo'i spyod yul 'dis/ /sems can sangs rgyas thob byed pa'o/ /dang po bskal pa grangs med nas/ /bsags pa'i sdig pa gang dang gang*/ /de kun zad par 'gyur ba ni/ /zab mo'i dkyil 'khor mthong bas so/ / zhes brjod cing don yang bshad nas/ ku sha'i stan la seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis nyol la rmi lam rtog shig /nangs par dkyil 'khor chen po mthong bar 'gyur ro/ / zhes bsgo bar bya'o/ /de nas thun mong ma yin pa'i bsrung ba ni/ slob dpon gyi lag pa g.yon pa dris byugs shing*/ me tog gi bkra shis par zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgoms la/ sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs te byang sems su zhu ba zla ba la thim/ de bzhin du mgrin par yang gsal btab nas/ slob ma'i spyi bor lag pa bzhag la/ oṃ buddha a ta che ge mo'i kā ya adhi tiṣṭha yantu ma tsa la ma tsa la/ tiṣṭha tiṣṭha/ ha ra ha ra/ bi dha ra bi dha ra/ dra ba dra ba/ bho bha ga wan sarba buddha ka pā la badzra sya ya ka taṃ ma la kā ya shī ghraṃ ku ru ku ru hūṃ hūṃ hā hā/

zhes lan bdun bzlas/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo zla ba zhu nas slob ma'i lus la thim par bsam mo/ / de rnams slob ma sta gon no/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi nyi ma la/ nangs par sngar langs te he ru ka'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ thod pa'i nang du bzhag pa'i thig skud lnga so so'i sa bon las rgyal ba rigs lngar bskyed/ mchod bstod byas te bzhu nas/ thig chen brgyad gdab pa'i dus su/ 'jig rten khams ni ma lus pa'i/ /sangs rgyas la sogs 'gro ba'i don/ khyed kyi dus ni 'di yin no/ / zhes brjod/ ye thig dang las thig mtha' dag legs par btab la/ rdul tshon kha dog sna lnga dang*/ thig skud bzhin byin gyis brlabs nas/ 'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni rab sgrol byed/ /sangs rgyas thod pa rgyal chen po/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun kyi gnas/ /nyes pa kun las rnam grol ba/ /tshon gyi las la yang dag 'jug / ces brjod cing slob dpon gyi tshon thog mar dbye'o/ /thig tshon byin brlab kyi lag len ni/ bde mchog sogs spyi dang 'dra la/ thig tshon gyi mtshan nyid kyang logs su 'chad par 'gyur bas/ de dang de dag las shes par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ 'di rgyas par ma smos so/ /de ltar na dkyil 'khor zhag gi cho ga'o/ /de nas rgyan dang mchod pa rnams kyang bkram par bya ste/ rnam rgyal bum pa lhor sgo dang*/ las bum byang sgor 'god par bzhed de/ dkyil 'khor gyi zhal 'jig rten pa'i lha la bstan pa'i dbang du byas pa'o/ / rgyud las/ ba dan rnam pa brgyad kyis brgyan/ / zhes pa ltar/ phyogs kyi mdog can gyi ba dan brgyad kyang gtsugs/ gzhan spyi dang 'dra'o/ /sngon 'gro gtor ma dang*/ gnas yo byin brlab sngon du btang*/ skyabs 'gro nas bdud rtsi myang ba'i bar sgrub thabs nas 'byung bar ltar rdzogs par sgom/ spro na bgegs sbyang ba dang*/ til sbyang dang*/ khrus gsol bya/ bris pa'i dkyil 'khor/

a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swabha wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sngon gyi smon lam gyi= nas/ ngo mtshar bar byed pa'o/ / zhes pa'i bar gyi gzhal yas khang gdan bcas bskyed/ gzhal yas khang gi dbus kyi/ zhes pa nas/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so/ /de yang dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka sku mdog sngon po= nas/ rtsed 'jo'i rol pa can no/ /dpal he ru ka'i zhal nas hūṃ zhes pa'i sgra bsgrags pas/ rnal 'byor ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi yang skad cig gis grub par gyur ste/ thugs kyi 'khor lo'i= nas/ zla ba'i rgyu 'bab pa'o/ / zhes brjod cing sgom ste dam tshig pa bskyed pa'o/ /'di skabs rim pa gsal ba las/ gtso bo hūṃ las skad cig gis bskyed par bshad pa ni/ zor yang bar dgongs pa ste bsdu na de ltar rung la/ yab rkyang du bshad pa ni cung zad mi legs shing*/ yang na gtso 'khor dus gcig tu bskyed kyang shin tu legs so/ / bdag skyed kyi bsgom pa'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor dbyer med du gyur/ rang gi thugs ka nas sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor spros te nam mkhar bzhugs/ arghaṃ= nas shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ rdo rje dang ni= sogs kyis bstod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ zhes dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor dang gnyis su med par bstim/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kar oṃ= nas/ don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i las kyi he ru ka phyag gnyis par gyur/ bsgrub mchod zhag sbrel ma byed pa'i dngos gzhi'i nyi ma rting ma rnams la/ skabs 'dir sta gon gyi skabs su bshad pa bzhin bum bskyed bzlas pa'i bar du bya'o/ /mchod pa byin rlabs bla med spyi dang mthun par byas/ dkyil 'khor dang bum pa'i lha la dus gcig tu mchod par bsam la mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ bsdu na bdag bskyed dam sta gon gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar gyis chog la/

cung zad spros pa la mos na/ dwangs shing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /sngags kyi yon chab mchog 'di dag / sogs dang*/ oṃ buddha ka pā la/ dza hūṃ khaṃ raṃ a/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ zhabs bsil dang*/ pā dyaṃ/ 'thor thung dang prokṣa ṇaṃ ste chu gsum 'bul/ oṃ lha y-i me tog shin tu dmar sogs dang*/ oṃ buddha ka pā li ni ma ṭa= sogs/ oṃ tsandan ga bur= sogs/ oṃ buddha ka pā li ni ta ṭa= sogs oṃ mar me'i 'od zer 'bar ba= sogs oṃ buddha kā pā li ni gṛhṇa= sogs/ sna tshogs lha yi dri zhim pa sogs dang*/ £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ oṃ £© mahā ka pā li= sogs oṃ kha dog dri dang = sogs dang*/ oṃ buddha ka pā li ni gṛhṇa nas/ khā khā hūṃ/ oṃ pa ṭa pa ṭa ha dang = sogs dang*/ oṃ badzra shapta āḥhūṃ/ gis rol mo phul/ gos zung 'bul ba yang spyi dang 'dra ba las/ sngags ni/ oṃ mahā ka pā la= badzra dharma= sogs so/ /gzhan yang spro na lha mo bcu drug dang*/ rin chen bdun dang*/ 'dod yod lnga la sogs pas mchod/ de nas bstod pa ni/ rdo rje dang ni= sogs dang*/ hūṃ chos dbyings rnam dag dbyings las byung*/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad khro bo'i sku/ / mi bzad ha har bzhad pa yi/ khrag 'thung sku la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /bdud kyi dkyil 'khor pham mdzad cing*/ /rdo rje hūṃ mdzad yi ge hūṃ/ /cha lugs du ma rab tu 'jigs/ /'jigs byed 'jigs par mdzad la 'dud/ /seng ge 'phrog byed tshangs pa'i gtsos/ /gang gi zhabs la phyag 'tshal ba/ khams gsum dbang phyug srid gsum 'joms/ /dpa' bo'i dbang phyug khyod la 'dud/ /gnyug ma'i dga' ma lhan cig skyes/ /bdag med don gyi ye shes dngos/ /sems can kun la phan dgyes pa/ /sna tshogs bde ma la phyag 'tshal/ /bsam gyis mi khyab pa yi thugs/ /shes bya kun la rab g.yo ba/ /mkha' spyod rnal 'byor skur ston pa/ / phreng bzang ma sogs la phyag 'tshal/ /zag med bde ba bcud kyi len/ /ye shes bdud rtsis gang ba yis/

/thod pa bzhi po rab sprul ba/ /mchod pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /gang gi gsung dbyangs mi zad pa/ /'gro kun bsam pa ji bzhin 'jug /sa spyod rnal 'byor ma yi tshul/ /dge ba'i ske rags can sogs 'dud/ /ji lta ji ltar 'dul ba'i sku/ /sna tshogs sprul pa thabs kyi don/ /sa 'og spyod pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ /sgrol byed ma sogs phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dgug dang*/ /mngon spyod 'phrin las spyod mdzad cing*/ /'gro ba'i don la gzhol ba yi/ /sgo skyong rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba'i khang bzang nyams dga' ba/ /e yig bha ga chos kyi dbyings/ /rgyan rnams kun kyis rab brgyan pa/ /gzhal med khang la gus phyag 'tshal/ /sna tshogs rdo rje padma nyi/ /dur khrod chen po'i rab bskor zhing*/ /rdo rje'i gur bcings la sogs pa/ / de dag rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / ces pas bstod par bya'o/ /de nas rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/ snying ga'i hūṃ las lha mo brgyad cig car sprul= zhes pa nas/ 'di dag gis ni mchod par bya/ / zhes pa'i bar brjod la/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i= zhes pa nas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum bar sgrub thabs ltar nang gi bdud rtsi myang ba dang*/ phyi'i bdud rtsi byin rlabs rnams bya/ de nas nang mchod 'bul ba ni/ he ru ka dpal ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /blo gros rin chen grub thob sa ra ha/ /klu sgrub shā wā ri dang mai tri pa/ /mar pa lo tsā tshul ston dbang nge dang*/ /ro mnyam rdo rje rgya ston yon tan grags/ kham pa shaka rdor bar btang chos kyi grags/ /rgan lhas pa dang chos rje bsod nams 'phel/ /bag ston gzhon tshul mkhas grub brag dkar ba/ khyud lhas pa dang grub chen kun blo'i zhabs/ /bla chen grags rin nam mkha' tshul khrims dang*/ /zla ba rgyal mtshan chos kyi seng ge dang*/ /nam mkha' rin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma ste/ /brgyud ldan bla ma kun la mchod pa 'bul/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/

gtso bo'i snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags pa/ lan bdun gyis dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul/ mchod pa'i mgron rnams la 'bul tshul yang bde dgyes sogs dang 'dra/ mthar bdag nyid kyi bdud rtsi myangs nas/ oṃ a mṛ ta swā da na badzra swa bha wa atma ko3haṃ/ de'i rjes su 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma 'bul te/ sta gon gyis skabs su bshad pa bzhin no/ /de dag ni dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas khrus dang maṇḍal sngon du 'gro bas/ āḥkhaṃ wī ra hūṃ/ gyis mig dar bcings shing me tog bzung*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo/ / rnal 'byor gnas la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ / mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /don dam smra ba'i seng ge rnal 'byor zhes bya ba/ /nyon mongs gcod pa'i don la shin tu mkhas gyur pa/ /srid pa'i nyes brgya skyed rtsa nyon mongs choms mdzod la/ /rnal 'byor don dam rgyal po de nyid grub par mdzod/ / ces lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ kye khyod su yin/ zhes dris pa'i lan du/ bdag ni rgyal ba'i sras so/ / de nas dkyil 'khor la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ / lan gsum/ lhas gnang ba sbyin par mos/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ yol ba'i nang du bcug par mos/ oṃ na ma ste hūṃ/ na mo me hūṃ/ na mo na maḥhūṃ/ zhes thun mong du phyag bya/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī pu dza u pa sthā na ya ātma naṃ ni tya ta ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta wī ra yo gi nī ātma su ma la a dhi tiṣṭhā swa maṃ/ zhes shar sgo dang*/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī pu dza a bhi ṣe ka ya ātma naṃ nirya ta ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta wī ra yo gi nā

ི ātma kā ma ni a bhi ṣiñtsantu maṃ/ zhes byang sgo dang*/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī pu dza a pra warta nā ya ātma naṃ nirya ta ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta wī ra yo gi nī/ ātma bhi ma pra warta ya maṃ/ zhes nub sgo dang*/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī pu dza karma ṇe ātma naṃ nirya ta ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta wi ra wo gi nī ātma arya garma ku ru maṃ/ zhes lho phyogs nas phyag 'tshal/ skabs 'dir rim pa gsal ba las/ thal mo 'god pa spyi dang cung zad mi 'dra ba bshad mod kyang*/ spyi dang mthun par snying ga spyi gtsug mgrin pa dpral ba rnams su rim bzhin sbyar ro/ / de nas sdom pa bsgrags pa ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song*/ /'di ni sangs rgyas rigs yid 'ong*/ /sdom pa brtan por gyur ba'o/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*/ /blo chen khyod kyi bzung bar bya/ /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ /shes rab dril bu zhes bsgrags so/ / slob dpon khyod kyis bzung bar bya/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ / 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa yin par bshad/ rin chen rigs la rtag tu ni/ /nyin re bzhin yang lan drug tu/ /chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs byams/ / sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung*/ /'di ni padma'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba'o/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ / yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ / de nas sdom pa bzung ba ni/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de ltar bdag gis bgyid par 'tshal/ / lan gsum mo/ / rang gi snying gar zla ba'i steng du rdo rje rtse lnga pa gnas pa'o/ / me tog phreng ba dang bcas pa'i rdo rje lnga pa snying gar bzung la/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta u pa ta ya mi/ zhes sems bskyed/

rdo rje snying gar gtad/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya staṃ hoḥsiddha badzra ya tha su khaṃ/ zhes so/ / oṃ badzra kuṇḍa li badzra hūṃ phaṭa/ las bum gyi chus bsangs/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūṃ/ dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs par mos/ /de nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ deng khyod dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ ngas khyod la dpal he ru ka'i ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan rnams lta ci zhig smos/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ zhes dang*/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur/ /gal te tshul 'di smras gyur na/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ / zhes dang*/ mna' chu 'thung zhing*/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis thob/ oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta u da ka ṭha ṭha ṭha hūṃ/ zhes dang*/ de nas brtsams te khyod kyi dpal he ru ka nga yin gyi/ gang ngas 'di byos shig ces bsgo ba de bya dgos so/ khyed kyi nga la brnyas par yang ma byed cig khyod mi bde ba ma spangs par dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung ba 'gyur ta re/ zhes pa'o/ /de nas ye shes dbab pa ni/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /dpal he ru ka dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi ye shes bdag la dbab tu gsol/ /rang gi snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ dpal sangs rgyas thod pa yab yum kha sbyor gyi sku/ 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'bar ba/ sku chung la yan lag dod par gyur/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas mkha' gsang bskyod pa las byung ba'i 'od zer dmar pos lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas lus sems thams cad bde bas khyab/

gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas/ dpal he ru ka mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs te/ rang nyid la gnyis su med par thim par gyur/ oṃ tiṣṭha mahā kro dha ā be sha hūṃ/ oṃ shrī he ru ka bid ma he bitya rā dza ya dhī ma he swāhā/ zhes rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te dbab bo/ / oṃ tiṣṭha badzra/ zhes spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram bzhag ste brtan par mos/ lha rnams rigs kyi rim pa bzhin/ /bsod nams ci 'dra de 'drar shog /'di yi dngos grub ci 'drar 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog /pra tītstsha badzra hoḥ zhes me tog dang*/ oṃ pra ti gṛhṇa twaṃ e maṃ satwa mahā ba la/ zhes me tog rang gi spyi bor bzhag /rang gi las dang rjes su mthun par nam mkha'i kha dog mthong bar mos/ slob ma dbang bskur gyi dus/ skabs 'dir nam mkha'i kha dog brtag he ru ka dpal dang khyod kyi/ / mig 'byed pa ni brtson par mdzad/ /bye bas thams cad mthong bar yang*/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ badzra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥ

zhes mig dar phye/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /da ni dang ba rab tu skye/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ /'gro ba phun sum tshogs kun dang*/ /dngos grub kun khyod mngon du gyur/ /dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang*/ /sngags rnams la yang brtson par gyis/ / zhes lta bar bskul/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad mngon sum bzhin du gsal bar gyur/ zhes brjod/ slob ma dbang bskur gyi skabs su/ skabs 'dir mngon rtog ltar lha ngo bstan no/ / sna tshogs padma'i gdan steng nas/ /gnyis su med pas legs par 'khyud/ /dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin can/ /dngos grub ma lus stsol ba po/ khrag 'thung che la bu khyod ltos/ /sna tshogs bde mas gtsor mdzad pa'i/ /phreng bzang ma sogs lha mo lnga/ /thod pa bzhi por bcas pa yi/ /rab zab thugs kyi 'khor lo dang*/ /dge ba'i ske rags can la sogs/ gsung gi rnam dag 'khor lo dang*/ /sgrol byed mkha' 'gro ma la sogs/ /rnam dag sku yi 'khor lo ste/ / rab dang 'bring dang tha ma can/ /mdzes sdug la sogs lha mo bzhi/ /gzugs sogs dag pa'i bdag nyid 'gyur/ /lha rnams de nyid mtshan ma yin/ / zhes brjod/ de rnams ni 'jug pa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas dbang dngos ni bum dbang gi don du maṇḍal phul la/ he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba/ /'gro ba skyob pa'i gzi brjid can/ /ji ltar yon tan 'byung gnas stsal/ /de bzhin bdag la deng stsol cig /dpa' bo chen po mi bzlog pa'i/ /dbang bskur ba ni bdag la stsol/ /sems can kun kyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon gyur/ / lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i phyogs su dbang staigs seng khri padma gdan nang tshangs can brtsegs pa'i steng du/ bdag nyid dpal he ru ka zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ sku mdog sngon po ḍā ma ru kha ṭwāṃ ga gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i skur gyur/

steng du gdugs dang mtha' skor du mchod pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su gang bar byas/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i lte bar gtum mo 'bar bas/ zhes pa nas/ me tog la sogs pa'i char phab cing*/ dbang bskur bar mdzad do/ / zhes brjod/ yungs kar gyis brab cing gtso bo'i sngags brjod/ rnam rgyal bum pa bteg ste me tog 'thor zhing*/ oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba/ sogs kyis shis pa brjod cing rol chen bya'o/ /de nas/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ / oṃ he ru ka wī ra twaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa/ zhes bum pa'i chus dbang bskur te/ rig pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul can rnams kyis dbang bskur bar gyur/ dbu rgyan bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ hūṃ oṃ swā hrīḥkhaṃ rnams las byung ba'i dbu rgyan dar dpyangs dang bcas pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i ngo bo/ rigs lnga'i sku gzugs kyis mtshan par gyur/ dbu rgyan dang dar dpyangs bcings la/ thor tshugs cod pan gyis brgyan pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rab bsngags pa'i/ /rin chen dbu rgyan dam pa dang*/ /dar dpyangs dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /oṃ pa ṭa ka badzra a ra li ho/ de nas rdo rje rtse dgu pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las dpal rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ de nyid zhu ba las byung ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi ngo bor rdo rjer gyur/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje yi/ /dbang gis de ring khyod dbang bskur/ /sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir/ /rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis long*/ /oṃ badzra a dhi pa ti twaṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ rdo rje gsor zhing snying gar gtad la/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun du bzang po kun bdag

nyid/ /rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag / ces rdo rje'i de kho na nyid bsam/ dril bu bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ rang snang pa'i thabs kyis 'khyud pa/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i rtse dgu pa'i mtshan pa'i dril bur gyur/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi/ / shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcings/ / byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /oṃ shri he ru ka a dhi pa ti twaṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa tiṣṭha bī ra sa ma ya twaṃ/ dril bu lan brgyad du dkrol la dkur bsten/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis dngos med byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' mchog /srid pa dam pa byed par shog / ces dril bu'i de kho na nyid dran par bya'o/ /de la rim pa gsal ba las/ rdo rje chen po rtse dgu pa/ /de nyid ldan pas byin brlabs nas/ /zhes 'byung ba ni/ rdo rje'i de kho na nyid/ /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ / zhes sogs dran pa yin gyi/ lha nyi shu rtsa bdun gyi de nyid dran pa la sogs pa ni ma yin no/ /des na/ 'dir rdo rje dang dril bu rdor sems yab yum du bskyed/ yab rdo rje dang yum dril bur bsgyur nas/ dbang de nyid rim can du bskur yang legs par 'gyur te/ rim pa gsal ba'i bzhed pa yang de yin no/ /rdor dril snying gar 'khyud rgya byas la/ bdag nyid dpal he ru ka yum sna tshogs bde mas 'khyud pa/ thugs rgyud bde ba chen pos gang bar gyur/ rdo rje dril bu yang dag 'khyud/ / g.yon snyems pa dang sgros snon 'chang*/ /gnyis med gnyis med rnal 'byor te/ /phyag rgya chen por byin gyis brlabs/ / zhes phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig dran par bya'o/ / dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba byung*/ zhal nas thon/ rang gi kha sgo nas zhugs/ snying ga'i hūṃ la thim/

snying po lan gsum brjod/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi/ /bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ / lan gsum/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ / 'dir gzhung las/ byin brlab che ldan sngags kyis ni/ / sngags kyi dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /zhes 'byung ba ni/ sngags dbang ster dgos pa'i don yin gyi/ tshig de brjod dgos pa'i don ma yin no/ / de nas dpal he ru ka yab yum gyi ngo bo rdo rje dril bu spyi bor bzhag pas lus 'od kyis gang bar bsam la/ oṃ shrī he ru ka a dhi pa ti twaṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ shrī he ru ka nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kye dpal/ zhes gsang mtshan dran par bya/ ming gi dbang ngo*/ / de ltar dbang de rnams bskur bas/ nyon mongs pa lnga dag / phung po lnga gnas gyur/ ye shes lnga mngon du bya'o/ /sangs rgyas lnga'i 'phrin las bsgrub pa la dbang ngo*/ /bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin par gyur/ rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo rdo rje lag tu gtod la/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /he ru ka dpal phyag na 'dug khyod kyi kyang ni rtag tu bcang*/ /he ru ka dpal brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta siddhi badzra sa ma ya/ /tiṣṭha e ṣa twaṃ/ dha ra yā mi hūṃ/ ha ha ha hoḥ rdo rje brtul zhugs so/ / rang nyid sangs rgyas thod pa he ru ka'i skur gyur/ hūṃ las byung ba'i phyag mtshan rnams gtad/ he ru ka dpal kha ṭwāṃ ga /rnal 'byor ma ni ḍā ma ru/ /rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ rdo rjer bcas/ /dril bu sil sil sgra sgrog cing*/ /tshangs pa'i skud thogs rnal 'byor bdag kha ṭwāṃ ga dang rnal 'byor snod/ /dpa' bo chen pos blang bar bgyi/ / spyod pa'i brtul zhugs so/ / de nas dbang gi lha rnams gtso bo'i thugs ka'i rtsa brgyad la thim/ spros pa la dga' na chu dbang nas 'di'i bar dbang rdzas la gnas gsum byin rlabs/

ye shes spyan 'dren/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab rnams byed pa dang*/ dbang lnga la slob ma'i mchod pa dang*/ rtogs skyed sogs/ spyi dang mthun pa dang*/ bar 'di lha mchod pa dang*/ mig thur sogs rjes gnang rgyas pa'ang byas pas chog go /'on kyang spros pa tsam du rig par bya'o/ / zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug /sdang dang dbye dang mnan la sogs/ /bsad dang bskradapa thams cad ste/ /las de rnams ni bsgrub par bgyi/ /ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang*/ / mchil lham de bzhin ril bu ste/ / rnal 'byor ma yi dngos grub ni/ /de ni ci dgar bsgub par bgyi/ / rjes gnang ngo*/ /de nas lung bstan ni/ he ru ka dpal lung ston bzhin/ / mgrin gcig tu ni thams cad kyi/ /'di ltar nga yis lung bstan te/ /he ru ka dpal de bzhin gshegs/ /dngos po mchog tu grub pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /shrī he ru ka nā ma/ ta thā ga ta tiṣṭha siddhi sa ma ya twaṃ/ bhu ra bhuḥwa swaḥ gsang mtshan dran par bya ste/ lung bstan no/ / mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ / zhugs pa dang ni mthong bas kyang*/ /sdig pa kun las nges grol te/ /de ring khyod rnams bde bar gnas/ /dbang 'di bskur ba tsam gyis ni/ / slob ma yon tan bdag por 'gyur/ /slob dpon nyid kyang bde ba yi/ /brtan g.yo kun gyi dam tshig yin/ /nangs par sngar langs sems dag nyid/ /ma lus las ni byas nas kyang*/ /srung dang bza' ba la sogs pa/ /sdom pa'i bdag nyid kyis bsrung ngo*/ /lus dang srog la ltos med par/ /dam tshig dang ni sdom pa bsrung*/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /nyin re bzhin yang bzla bar bya/ /gang tshe nyams gyur rnal 'byor pa/ kha na ma tho sbom por 'gyur/ /dgun zla 'bring po nas brtsams te/ /zla ba re re bsrung ba ni/ /gnyis med gnyis med 'khor lo gnas/ /tshes bcu la ni de rab mchod/ /chang dang sha sogs gang ci'ang rung*/ / dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs/

/thams cad gnyis med dbang na gnas/ / he ru ka dpal rab tu mchod/ /theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya/ / sems can la yang rgyab mi phyogs/ /'khor ba dag kyang mi spong zhing*/ /mya ngan 'das la dgar mi rung*/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma kun la/ khyod kyis brnyas par mi bya ste/ /phyag rgya gzhom pa mtshon cha dang*/ /mtshan ma 'god par mi bgyid do/ /dam tshig rab bsrung bsod nams kyis/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur/ /bud med thams cad mthong ba na/ /g.yon nas lan gsum bskor bya zhing*/ /spyi bos phyag ni byas nas kyang*/ /lan gsum bar du gsol ba gdab/ /bdag bu khyod nyid ma yin te/ /ji srid byang chub 'byung bar du/ /byang chub yan lag nu ma las/ /byung ba'i rang gi 'o mas skyongs/ /gnyis med ye shes dpyod ldan par/ /bslab pa blangs pa sngon 'gro bas/ /sgra sogs stong pa sngon 'gro ba'i/ /tshangs par spyod pa shin tu srungs/ /dam tshig de la rtag gnas te/ /de sngon 'gro ba sbas pa'i yid/ /spyod dang grol ba'i gnas 'dod pa'i/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub 'gyur/ / zhes dkyil 'khor gyi bdag pos gsungs par bsam shing*/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ / de ltar bdag gis bgyid par 'tshal/ / lan gsum gyis khas blang ngo*/ / de ltar bum pa'i dbang thob pas/ /bskyed rim 'phrin las kun la dbang*/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob cing*/ /sprul sku'i go 'phang mngon du 'gyur/ / gsang ba'i dbang gi don du maṇḍal phul/ bdag ni 'khor ba'i 'dam du bying*/ /dpung gnyen mdzod cig skyob pa po/ /bdag ni skal dman rtsol ba chung*/ /sangs rgyas chos dang rnam bral bas/ /kyai ston pa bla ma che/ /mgon po khyod kyis brtse bar mdzod/ / ces lan gsum/ de nas/ oṃ he ru ka wī ra twaṃ/ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa/ zhes chu dbang dang*/ oṃ pa ṭaṃ ka badzra ā ra li hoḥ zhes dbu rgyan dang*/ oṃ badzra a dhī pa dhi twaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ zhes rdo rje dang*/

oṃ shrī he ru ka a dhi pa dhi twaṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa tiṣṭha bī ra sa ma ya twaṃ/ zhes dril bu dang*/ oṃ shrī he ru ka a dhi pa dhi twaṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ shrī he ru ka nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ zhes ming gi dbang bskur ro/ /'dir de tsam gyi don 'grub par mthong bas/ zor yang pa'i dbang du byas la/ gzhung las/ sngar gsungs cho ga bzhin du ni/ /chu sogs dbang rnams bskur bar bya/ /ces sngags dbang ma gtogs gong bzhin bskur bar bshad pa yin te/ spros pa la dga' na de ltar bya'o/ /sgyu thod kyi dkyil chog rim pa gsal ba gnyis kyi lugs la/ skabs 'dir 'di lta bu bshad kyi/ rgyud dang dkyil chog gzhan phal cher las mi 'byung bas/ mi spro na ma byas kyang chog go / ā khaṃ bī ra hūṃ gis gdong g.yogs/ yid kyi lus ni brtan pa'i phyir/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig rab tu brjod/ /gang gi lus ni thams cad brtan/ /des na phyag rgyar rab tu bsgrags/ /bla ma he ru ka yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ yab yum gyi sku la zhugs/ thugs kar byang chub kyi sems su zhugs/ gsang bar lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes brtan par byas pa'i byang chub kyi sems bdag gi lce thog tu bzhag /'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs kyi/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas sras dbang bskur/ /byang chub sems ni bzang po yis/ /de ltar bu khyod dbang bskur ro/ / snying po'i mthar/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes brjod/ bdud rtsi myangs/ a ti su khaṃ/ zhes brjod/ gdong g.yogs bsal/ de ltar gsang ba'i dbang thob pas/ /sngags bzlas rlung sogs sgom la dbang*/ /sa bcu pa dang skal ba mnyam/ /longs sku'i go 'phang mngon du 'gyur/ / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du maṇḍal phul/ bdag ni 'khor ba'i 'dam du bying*/ /rnam rtog mang dang bdag ldan pas/ /bag chags yang dag bcad pa yi/ /mdzes ma khyod kyis skyob par mdzod/

/grags pa chen po snying rje che/ /lha mo des ni zhi bar mdzod/ / ces lan gsum/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo he ru ka yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i rjes chags kyi rkyen gyis/ lte bar gtum mo sbar bas bde ba= zhes pa nas/ gsung bzhin par gyur/ kyai ā hoḥ dper na bu tsha med pa'i khyim/ /shi ma thag tu stong par 'gyur/ /de bzhin dbang dang bral na ni/ /ye shes kun du stong pa nyid/ /dper na pi waṃ sbyor sogs kun/ /rgyud dang bral na rdung mi rung*/ /de bzhin dbang dang bral na ni/ /sngags dang bsam gtan 'grub mi 'gyur/ / rmongs pa gang zhig dbang med par/ /bdag ni dbang bskur zhes smra ba/ /ji srid sangs rgyas zhugs kyi bar/ /slob mar bcas te dmyal bar 'gro/ / zhes nyes dmigs bsgrags so/ /'di bram ze chen po'i gzhung 'grel du grags pa 'di dag tu/ gong ma'i dbang gsum la so sor phral te sbyar yang*/ de 'dra'i nges pa mi snang bas/ 'dir chabs gcig tu sgrog go /de nas

yang dang yang du phyag 'tshal te/ zhes pa nas char phab cing dbang bskur bar mdzad do/ / zhes brjod/ gong gsal dbang gi skabs ltar dbang lnga dang*/ yid kyi lus su= sogs/ phyag rgya'i dam tshig dang*/ 'das pa'i rdo rje= sogs kyis gsang dbang yang bskur bar mos/ de nas yang sngon bzhin mig dar bcings/ dbang gi lha mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis gdams par mos la/ bcu gnyis lo lon bu mo ni/ /tshul khrims ma nyams chags chung ba/ /thos dang ldan zhing grags chen mo/ /nad med snying rje dang ldan pa/ /sems can don la gcig nan tan/ / dgod cing padma'i spyan dang ldan/ /zla ba'i cha 'dra gdong mdzes ma/ /mu cor mi smra brtan zhing dul/ /shes rab padma'i nang dbus su/ /dpag tshad bye ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /sum brtsegs dag pa'i bdag nyid lus/ /'khor ba'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa/ /dkyil 'khor de yi dbus gnas pa'i/ /mkhas pa'i slob ma bzang dbang bskur/ /gal te byang chub bla med 'dod/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor bya ba min/ /lha rnams bshig pa tsam gyis ni/ /sdig pa chen por skye bar 'gyur/ / des na rdul tshon tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhi lha rnams dag mi 'gyur/ /rdo rje 'khor lo rin chen dang*/ /de bzhin padma ral gri nyid/ /byas nas slar yang 'jig byed pa/ /skyes bu tha shal dmyal bar 'gro/ /gang gis sangs rgyas spyan 'dren zhing*/ / gang gis gshegs su gsol ba yin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' byon pa dang*/ /de bzhin gshegs pa byon pa rnams/ /gang na'ang bzhugs pa ma yin te/ /dri ma med cing dag pa'i lus/ /gang gis spyan drangs gshegs su gsol/ /de nyid kyis na brtag med par/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams phyag bya/ /de nas mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i rig ma gtad par mos la/ gang gis shes rab ma mnyes par/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyis ni mchod/ /'di nyid la ni sangs rgyas bzhugs/ /gzhan gang dngos grub gtso bo dang*/ /snying rje ldan pa gzhan gang zhig

/mkha' 'gro ma kun 'di la bzhugs/ /gsang ba phyi yi lnga dang ni/ /bdun dang bcu bzhir bshad pa dang*/ /gnyis ka gcig tu 'dus pa'o/ / zhes so/ /de nas spro na bar 'dir/ dri ba dri lan sogs kyang bya/ bdag dang rig ma gnyis ka mi dmigs te stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka sku mdog sngon po= nas/ rtsed 'jo'i rol pa can no/ /yab yum gnyis ka'i thugs kar oṃ= nas/ rdo rje'i lte ba la hūṃ/ yum gyi bha ga hrīḥlas= nas/ oṃ dkar pos mtshan pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas/ lugs 'byung dang lugs zlog gi dga' ba bzhi mngon du byas par gyur/ 'dod chags ma yin chags bral min/ /dbu mar dmigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /gsum po spangs pa kho na las/ /lhan cig skyes pa byang chub brjod/ /gang du dbang po nyams gyur dang*/ /bdag gi rang bzhin rnam par nyams/ /lhan cig skyes dga' rtogs de yin/ /bla ma'i zhal las gsal 'dri na'o/ / zhes brjod/ gdong g.yogs bsal/ de ltar shes rab dbang thob pas/ /las dang ye shes lam la dbang*/ /bcu gnyis pa dang skal mnyam zhing*/ /chos sku'i go 'phang mngon du 'gyur/ de nas dbang bzhi pa'i don du maṇḍal phul/ khyod zhabs padmo'i bka' drin gyis/ /gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob/ /de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang*/ /bdag la bka' drin skyabs du gsol/ / lan gsum/ gang zhig shar dus tshe na dbang po dang*/ /yul rnams nub gyur de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhas pa rnams kyi snying sbas su sad pa/ /phyis ni mngon dga' rgyal ba'i mdzes sku gcig /so so rang gis rigs gdod ma nas gnas pa'i ye shes/ mngon gsum du shar na gzung 'dzin nub par snang la/ rtogs bya dang rtogs byed dbye ba med pas sems nyid kyi rang bzhin lhan cig skyes dga' rnam pa thams cad pa'o/ /de ltar yang*/ phyag rgya chen po thig le las/ /yang dag dri med rnam pa'i 'od/ /gang du yang na gnas med do/

/shar ba ma yin nub pa min/ /rtag tu shar ba char yang mchog / ces gsungs so/ / mtshams med lnga re byed pa dang*/ /rmongs gang ma rung las byed dang*/ /skye ba dman gyur 'gro ba rnams/ /rdul tshon mthong bas grol bar 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor dag tu mngon zhugs pas/ /gtsang ma'i gnas su skye bar 'gyur/ /shin tu sbyor ba'i sems kyis ni/ /skye 'dir dngos grub ma thob kyang*/ / skye gzhan srid par dngos grub 'gyur/ /dbang bskur yang dag sbyin ldan na/ /skye dang skye bar dngos grub 'gyur/ /de yi skye ba bdun la ni/ /ma bsgrub par yang dngos grub thob/ /gang yang sgom pa dang ldan zhing*/ /gal te dam tshig sdom la gnas/ /skye 'dir las dbang gis ma grub/ /re zhig dam tshig nyams pa la/ / dngos grub thob pa lta zhog gi /mi yi skye ba'ang rnyed par dka'/ /gang yang bla ma brgyud pa yi/ /rim 'ongs de nyid rig pa yi/ /sgrub pa po yis 'grub snyam dgongs/ / zhes dam tshig bshad do/ / de ltar bzhi pa'i dbang thob pas/ /phyag rgya chen po bsgom par dbang*/ /rdo rje 'dzin dang skal mnyam ste/ /lhan cig skyes sku mngon du 'gyur/ / zhes so/ / gtso bos ji ltar= sogs lan gsum/ gtang rag gi maṇḍal phul/ deng nas brtsams te= sogs dge ba bsngo/ skabs 'd-i'i mchod gtor gyi mthar/ sbyin bsreg dang tshogs kyi 'khor lo sogs ci 'grub tu bya'o/ /de dag n-i bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'o/ / slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba yang de nyid 'don pa spos pas 'grub par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ zlos te brjod par ma byas so/ /de nas rjes chog gi mchod pa bshams la byin gyis brlabs/ arghaṃ nas shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ rdo rje dang ni= sogs kyis bstod/ bdud rtsi phul/ 'dod don gsol btab/ yig brgya bzod gsol rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor gshegs su gsol ba dang*/ ras bris yin na brtan bzhugs bya ba dang*/ rdul tshon cho ga nyin zhag sbrel ma'i skabs/

zhag snga ma rnams la brtan bzhugs dang*/ /phyi ma la gshegs gsol bya ba dang*/ mthar rang la go cha dgod cing*/ smon lam dang bkra shis rnams bya ste spyi dang 'dra'o/ /zab mo blo mig dag pas mthong ba na/ / dad pa'i snying la mi g.yo'i go skabs ci/ /nges pa'i gzhung dang mthun par legs sbyar ba'i/ /dkyil chog 'dis kyang 'gro la phan par 'gyur/ /dge des bcom ldan rdo rje snying rje'i stobs/ /rdo rje btsun mo'i bde bas rol pa can/ /mnyam med de dang mnyam par nyer spyod pa'i/ /gsang ba'i bdag dang mtshungs par da gyur cig/// ces pa dpal sangs rgyas thod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga de kho na nyid gsal ba zhes bya ba 'di yang*/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ maṅga laṃ/ slob dpon nag po spyod pa'i lugs kyi 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga shes pas/ 'di la 'jug par bya'o/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/dpal sangs rgyas thod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga de kho na nyid gsal ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/ - PAGE 240 -- PAGE 241 -- PAGE 225 -
